name: Portolan

primary.name: Portolan blue
primary._usage: The single accent. Links, logo fill, figure strokes, controls. Portolan carries one accent color and no second one.

ink.name: Near-black ink
ink._usage: Body text and structural rules. The heavy line weight is deliberate.

rule_soft.name: Soft rule
rule_soft._usage: Interior separators inside an already-bordered block, and nowhere else. Structural rules stay ink.

sans._register: Human register: headlines and prose. Latin text.

mono._register: Machine register: code, labels, eyebrows, kickers, data, statuses, paths, numbers, and controls.

arabic._note: Never letterspace Arabic. The script is connected, and tracking breaks it.

rules._note: Standing rules that hold on any Portolan surface. Implementation details belong in each repo's own AGENTS.md.
rules.fonts: Three families, no others in production.
rules.type_registers: The sans/mono split is a register split, not decoration. Never set headlines or body paragraphs in mono.
rules.color_mode: Light mode only. No dark theme, no theme toggle, no dark token block.
rules.corners: Square. Every radius token is 0px, so buttons, inputs, and content blocks all carry 90-degree corners. The one permitted circle is a loading spinner.
rules.surfaces: Flat. Separate content with near-black rules, not cards or soft background bands. Shadow tokens render as none or as a single rule, never a glassy drop shadow.
rules.nautical_cliche: Compass roses and rhumb lines are banned.
